skill.name: req-change-workflow
skill.description: Guides controlled requirement changes in existing codebases. It locks scope, confirms current behavior, assesses risk, designs the change, validates regressions, and records decisions.
skill.summary: Run a gated workflow for safe requirement changes.

content.value_statement: Requirement changes often expand across files without clear approval points. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a gated workflow for scope, impact, validation, and documentation.
actual_capabilities: Turns a change request into target, out-of-scope items, acceptance criteria, constraints, and rollback expectations.
Prompts the agent to confirm current behavior from real code before proposing changes.
Uses an included impact scan script to find likely files with ripgrep.
Guides impact, risk, rollback, and validation planning before implementation.
Provides change brief, regression checklist, and decision log templates.
Requires approval before code edits begin in the recommended workflow.
limitations: It does not replace project-specific tests or code review.
The impact scan depends on ripgrep being available.
The workflow is optimized for existing codebases and Chrome extension changes.
It cannot verify behavior without access to the target repository and test environment.

use_cases.title: Scope a Feature Adjustment
use_cases.description: Convert a requested behavior change into clear acceptance criteria and boundaries before coding starts.

use_cases.title: Assess Extension Change Risk
use_cases.description: Review impact across manifest, service worker, storage, OAuth, and UI before changing a Chrome extension.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Change Reviews
use_cases.description: Use the same brief, risk list, validation checklist, and decision log for repeated change requests.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Change Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Use req-change-workflow to turn my request into a change brief. Ask only for missing target, out-of-scope items, acceptance criteria, constraints, and rollback expectations.

prompt_templates.title: Map Current Behavior
prompt_templates.prompt: Use req-change-workflow to inspect the current behavior for this requirement. Summarize the entrypoints, data flow, key files, and assumptions before proposing changes.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Impact and Validation
prompt_templates.prompt: Use req-change-workflow to produce an impact list, risk assessment, rollback plan, and regression checklist for this accepted change request.

prompt_templates.title: Run Full Gated Change Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use req-change-workflow end to end. Lock scope, confirm current behavior from code, assess risk, propose a design, wait for approval, then implement minimal diffs and document validation.

output_examples.input: Change the side panel save flow so users see a clearer success message.
output: Change brief with target behavior, out-of-scope items, and acceptance criteria.
Current behavior summary listing side panel entrypoints and message handling.
Validation plan covering UI smoke checks and failure messages.

output_examples.input: Assess a requirement change that touches OAuth and local storage.
output: Impact list covering auth, storage migration risk, concurrency, and rollback.
Manual regression checklist for login, renewal, import, export, and old data compatibility.
Approval question before any implementation begins.

output_examples.input: Document why we chose the new implementation path.
output: Decision log summary with context, selected approach, rejected alternatives, risks, and rollback plan.
Short maintainer notes for future changes.

best_practices: Keep acceptance criteria observable before design starts.
Read the current implementation before proposing new logic.
Record validation results and rollback notes after the change.
anti_patterns: Starting implementation before the user approves scope and design.
Changing manifest, storage, or auth flows without a reload and regression plan.
Expanding the file list without updating the impact assessment.

faq.question: Can this skill edit code directly?
faq.answer: It guides code edits after scope, impact, and design approval. The workflow discourages editing before approval.

faq.question: Is it only for Chrome extensions?
faq.answer: No. It is optimized for Chrome extensions, but the gated change process works for many existing codebases.

faq.question: Does it run tests automatically?
faq.answer: No. It helps define validation steps and records results. The agent or user still runs project tests.

faq.question: Why does it include an impact scan script?
faq.answer: The script helps find likely files quickly with ripgrep. It is a local search helper, not a build or deployment tool.

faq.question: What makes the workflow safer?
faq.answer: It separates scope, baseline, impact, design, implementation, validation, and documentation into approval gates.

faq.question: Can it help with rollback planning?
faq.answer: Yes. It asks whether rollback is a simple revert or needs cleanup, migration, or backfill work.
